record.oneLiner: A small, bird-like theropod named for its distinctive serrated teeth.
record.description: Troodon is a small, bird-like theropod from the Late Cretaceous of North America, named for its serrated 'wounding' teeth. Those teeth actually resemble those of herbivorous reptiles, hinting at a possibly omnivorous diet. Its taxonomy is controversial — the genus is based on a single tooth.
